name: Generic Workflow
description: A basic loop for any domain: Plan → Execute → Review → Retrospect.

phases.title: Plan
phases.description: Break the goal into atomic tasks completable within a single session.
aiInstructions: Read .nextup/snapshots/latest_handoff.md and context.json first to calibrate goals and boundaries.
Break the work into atomic tasks under tasks/; each task title must be independently verifiable.
Write acceptance criteria and priority into each task description.

phases.title: Execute
phases.description: Complete tasks by priority; deliverables go into artifacts/.
aiInstructions: Claim tasks by priority and mark them in_progress — focus on one thing at a time.
If validate_task_specs is in your tool list, a task that changes behaviour writes its spec delta under tasks/<task-id>/specs/ before it is marked done (nextup_docs/modules/specs.md).
Mark done as soon as a task completes (the handoff refreshes automatically); mark blocked immediately with the reason when stuck.
All deliverables go into artifacts/ — never scatter them elsewhere.

phases.title: Review
phases.description: Verify the output against the project goals.
aiInstructions: Check artifacts/ against each goal in context.json; when goals are empty, verify against milestones and direction decisions in the ledger instead.
If anything is missing, go back and add tasks — never force a gate through.
Record the review conclusion and its rationale as a decision.

exitGates.prompt: Confirmed the output meets the project goals

phases.title: Retrospect
phases.description: The self-improvement flywheel: write what this cycle taught you back into the rules.
aiInstructions: Answer each question in flywheel.postMortemPrompts of rules.json.
Write actionable improvements back into executionGuidelines of rules.json and leave a revisionHistory entry.
Refresh the handoff snapshot once via the generate_handoff tool (or ask the user to click it in the GUI) so the next cycle starts from a clean snapshot.
